entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Oh, okay. I hope this works. I'm just so confused by the website...
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I... I have this jersey I bought, and I think I need to send it back. I have the order number if you need it. I just don't understand the process.

I can certainly look into that for you. And yes, please provide the order number when you're ready. Just so I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's... I guess it's the wrong size. I ordered a medium, which I always am, but this one is just way too tight. I can barely zip it up. I was hoping to exchange it, but the site was a bit overwhelming.
I understand, our race-fit items can be quite snug. Let me just pull up your order. One moment.
Okay, I see your order for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered 18 days ago. Not a problem at all. You are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief. The website had so many different sections, I got lost. So, what do I do? Can't you just help me? I'd really prefer an exchange for a large if possible.

Of course. The fastest way to handle the exchange is for you to return the current jersey for a full refund, and then you can place a new order for the correct size whenever you're ready. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Does that sound okay?
Yes! Oh, thank you. So you're sending a label and I just send the 'too tight' one back, and then I can order the new one? That's so much simpler. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. The email has been sent. Once we receive the original jersey, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thanks again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
